description: Aligns the SPIKE blueprint with dedicated task worktrees and governed integration.
delta: Replace the ambiguous throwaway Branch field and direct-to-main deliverable instruction with a canonical task branch and a separate optional local throwaway probe branch. Probe code is never merged or pushed; the canonical branch carries the deliverable and permitted lifecycle/evidence records through ordinary governed closure. Existing consumer task records are not rewritten.
verification: The managed task-blueprint v16 distinguishes canonical task and local probe branches.
SPIKE deliverables use ordinary governed worktree closure rather than direct commits to main.
Consumer-owned text and historical task records remain unchanged.
